qualification.details: Sl. No. 1 SRF and YP-II: knowledge of design, development and testing of machinery, machine design software, data analysis, statistical analysis, research paper and report writing skills and field work. how_to_apply: Fill the Application Format attached to the notice (PDF) for the post applied for. It asks for the post by Sr. No. (1 to 5) and the mode of interview (Online/Offline).

Complete the form: name, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age as on the closing date, nationality, addresses, e-mail address, education qualifications in chronological order, area of study and project details, experience, professional qualification, research publications and list of enclosures.
Affix a recent photograph and sign the declaration.
Email the application with all relevant documents to [email protected] on or before 11 November 2026, 05.30 pm.
Fill out the Google Form available on the Institute website along with the advertisement.
For hybrid mode, the interview link will be shared through the email ID the candidate communicates.
Attested copies of SC/ST/OBC/Ex-servicemen/PH certificates from the competent authority, where applicable.
Attested copy of certificates in proof of education qualifications.
Character certificate from the present employer and from the institute last attended.

For employees of public/private organisations: the employer's certificate on the form that information is verified from service records, no Vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and no minor/major penalty has been imposed during the last ten years.
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, for candidates currently employed elsewhere, before the interview.
All original experience/testimonials in support of age, qualifications and experience, to be brought to the interview.
important_instructions: No T.A./D.A. will be paid for appearing in the interview. The selected SRF/YPs may be posted at all regional units. Working hours are the same as regular employees of ICAR; no extra benefit is allowed for working beyond office hours. Unauthorized absence for a continuous period of 08 days without valid reasons leads to automatic termination of the engagement. SRF/YPs are eligible for 08 days casual leave in a calendar year on pro-rata basis and 02 restricted holidays. Unavailed leaves are not carried forward. Compensatory leave for holiday duty may be allowed, but not more than 02 leaves can accrue in a month. Female YPs get maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017. SRF/YPs will sign a declaration of secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement (Annexure-I) before reporting, and must comply with the Standards of Conduct; failure is a ground for termination without notice. The engagement does not constitute a regular job or appointment of any nature in the ICAR. Canvassing in any form is liable to disqualify the candidature. Information found false, incorrect, incomplete or ineligible, before or after selection/interview, makes the candidature liable to rejection or cancellation without notice. For queries, the Director Office can be contacted between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM on Mobile No. 9137582766.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIRCOT
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, with its office at Adenwala Road, Matunga, Mumbai - 400019. The notice invites engagement for programmes of the Mission on Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti) and for the Institute's Finance and Accounts Section. Program 5.1 covers post-harvest technologies including cleaning, ginning and quality profiling systems for mechanically harvested cotton. Program 5.2 covers an innovative cotton value chain to enhance farm profitability through circular economy.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists five numbered groups of posts, 16 posts in all. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential and desirable qualification. The table gives the essential qualification as printed; desirable points follow below it. Sl. No. 1 SRF: candidates having a post graduate degree in basic sciences with a 3-year bachelor's degree and a two-year master's degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience, as mentioned in the Council's OM dated 13th July, 2015 and 9th October, 2015 and OM SR/59/2-09/2018 of DST dated 30th Jan, 2019. Sl. No. 3 SRF: candidates having a 3-year bachelor's degree and a two-year Master degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience. Sl. No. 1 SRF and YP-II: knowledge of design, development and testing of machinery, machine design software, data analysis, statistical analysis, research paper and report writing skills and field work. Sl. No. 1 YP-I: preference to candidates with knowledge in erection/commissioning of Engineering Plants and machinery or working in industrial scale plants. Sl. No. 2 YP-II: experience in cotton fibre testing, textile testing, data analysis, project management etc. Sl. No. 2 YP-I (a): experience in spinning, weaving, garmenting, cotton fibre testing, textile testing, data entry and analysis, etc. Sl. No. 2 YP-I (b): experience in project management, computer skill, data entry, Advance excel, Telley etc. The candidate will be mainly required for project management and administrative work related to the project. Sl. No. 3 SRF: PhD in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Life Sciences with experience of molecular biology tools will be given preference. Sl. No. 3 YP-II: post graduate degree / diploma in Instrumentation & control / Sensor technology; experience in sensor fabrication and prototyping, spectroscopic characterization of materials, data acquisition and analysis, exposure to microcontrollers, RFID, signal processing and data handling using open-source software. Sl. No. 3 YP-I: experience in chemical synthesis. Sl. No. 4 YP-II: experience in molecular biology and genetic engineering techniques, fermentation process optimization, and extraction/characterization of biopolymers; knowledge of HPLC/GC analysis and statistical experimental design will be preferred. Sl. No. 4 YP-I: experience in lab experimentation/survey/fibre testing/spinning/waste management. Sl. No. 5 YP-I: knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Tally, etc.) will be an added advantage. The notice prints no "as on" date for counting age. The application format asks for age as on the closing date of application. The notice states these relaxations are "as per govt. rules". Two further notes are printed: for the Commerce and Information Technology category, graduation with a minimum 60% marks; for the Commerce category, a minimum of 1 year of experience in the relevant field. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary and contractual in nature. The engagement is up to completion of project period 2026-2031, subject to satisfactory performance after evaluation by the Director, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai. Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted under the prevailing rules is deducted at source before the monthly salary is paid. TA/DA is admissible for domestic tours for official work, as per ICAR rules.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CIRCOT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the nature of work for only the following posts. Molecular Biology work, designing of stable short chains of deoxy-ribonucleotides (marker DNA sequences) using bioinformatics tools. PCR-based analysis and validation of marker DNA sequences for cotton identification and traceability. Encapsulation of marker DNA sequences using suitable encapsulating agents for improving its stability. Screening of microbial strains for PLA production. Optimization of culture media and fermentation conditions. Molecular characterization and genetic modification of selected strains, as required. Laboratory scale fermentation; recovery and purification of PLA. HPLC analysis of fermentation products. The candidate will be mainly required for project management and administrative work related to the project.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice describes an interview in hybrid mode, with the venue, date and time given against each post: GTC, Nagpur on 16 November 2026, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai on 17 November 2026 and ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai on 23 November 2026 (see the vacancy table). Candidates choose Online or Offline mode in the application. The Director's decision is final and binding in all respects. Candidates currently employed elsewhere whose NOC is missing are liable to have the interview cancelled. The notice mentions no written test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIRCOT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 16 posts in all: 3 Senior Research Fellows, 4 Young Professionals-II and 9 Young Professionals-I, at ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai and GTC, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-CIRCOT SRF and Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 11 November 2026, 05.30 pm to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the ICAR-CIRCOT posts?
faq.answer: Fill the Application Format given with the notice and email it with all relevant documents to [email protected]. Candidates must also fill out the Google Form available on the Institute website along with the advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-CIRCOT SRF and YP posts?
faq.answer: For SRF it is a maximum of 35 years for men and 40 years for women. For YP-II and YP-I the minimum is 21 years and the maximum 45 years. SC/ST get 5 years, OBC 3 years and PH 10 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of SRF, YP-II and YP-I at ICAR-CIRCOT?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs.37000/- + HRA (as applicable) for SRF, Rs. 42000/- only for YP-II and Rs. 30000/- only for YP-I.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The notice prints "Rs.37000/- + HRA per month (as applicable)" for SRF only. For YP-II and YP-I it prints the amounts as "only".

faq.question: Q7. Is the ICAR-CIRCOT job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and contractual, up to completion of the project period 2026-2031, and the engagement does not constitute a regular job or appointment in the ICAR.

faq.question: Q8. When are the ICAR-CIRCOT interviews?
faq.answer: Interviews are on 16 November 2026 at GTC, Nagpur, on 17 November 2026 at ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai, and on 23 November 2026 at ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai for the Finance and Accounts Section post. The mode is hybrid.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A./D.A. will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates currently employed elsewhere must produce a No Objection Certificate from the present employer before the interview, or the interview is liable to be cancelled.
